title: Invalid JSON messages triggers an unhandled exception in JsonWebsocketConsumer and AsyncJsonWebsocketConsumer
author: JulienPalard
body_preview: Hi!  On malformed json sent by clients to `JsonWebsocketConsumer` or `AsyncJsonWebsocketConsumer`, a `JSONDecodeError` is raised and left unhandled.  The unhandled exception stops the django process (which will be restarted by Daphne so that's OKish). title: Now way to extend max message size limit in dev mode
author: corvis
body_preview: Release 4.2.2 introduces new CLI arguments websocket-max-message-size and websocket-max-frame-size with default value set to 1Mb. However in development mode (when you run application with `manage.py http`) there is no way to set these settings, as result if you application needs 2Mb you can't run it properly locally.

title: Low color contrast on dashboard dates on hover (dark mode)
author: bryan-oginga
